name: Support ticket routing
description: Route a customer support message to the right team and flag urgency. Labeled with the correct department and whether the message is urgent.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this support ticket?

criteria.other: Anything that fits none of the above

urgency.instructions: The message conveys urgency or time-sensitivity.

ticket.subject: Charged twice for the enterprise plan

messages.text: I see two charges of $449 on my card this month for the same enterprise plan. Please refund the duplicate right away. Monthly invoice #INV-2034 attached.
Since the latest release I get a 500 error whenever I try to sign in with SSO. This blocks all of our users.

ticket.subject: How much would unlimited seats cost

messages.text: We are evaluating adding 120 seats next quarter. Could you send a quote for annual billing?

ticket.subject: Can I change my company name on the invoice

messages.text: Our legal entity changed. How do I update the billing name shown on my invoices?

ticket.subject: Refund policy question after failed trial

messages.text: My team tested the product for 30 days but we decided not to continue, and I was still charged $99. I would like a full refund.
Our webhooks fired but your side did not deliver them for about 40 minutes last night. We missed several order events. This is urgent for our pipeline.
We are a registered non-profit. Do you offer pricing discounts, and if so who should we talk to about applying?
I deleted our main workspace by mistake. Can you restore it from backups as soon as possible? Members cannot access anything.
The API stops returning records at offset 10,000. Is that a hard limit and does the higher plan raise it?

ticket.subject: No reply to my purchase order

messages.text: I emailed a signed purchase order three days ago and have not heard back. Has billing received it?
My invoice shows 21% VAT but we are an exporting business and should be zero-rated. Please re-issue the invoice.

samples.state: Our CI builds started failing when the new SDK version removed the retry option. There is no workaround and our releases are stalled. Please fix asap.

ticket.subject: Where do I find my API keys

messages.text: I am looking for where to generate an API key for our integration but cannot find it in the dashboard.
I have been on hold with your support chat for an hour and nobody is answering. This is unacceptable.
